title: Inconsistent “clear” color
text: Inconsistent “clear” color. The 12 oz is clear. The 6 oz has a bluish green tint. I got these to be a full set so now they all have to go back. So disappointed. And yes I got the same brand. From the same seller. Both in color clear.

product_metadata.title: Darware Hobnail Drinking Glasses (12oz, 6pk, Blue); Old-Fashioned Beverage Glasses for Tabletop, and Bar Use and Candle Jars
features: SET OF 6: Receive 6 medium-sized beverage and cocktail glasses
SIZE: Each 4 inches tall and 3.5 inch diameter; CAPACITY: 12 fluid ounces = 1.5 cups (350ml)
MULTI-USE: Great for serving elegant mixed drinks, hard liquor, water or iced beverages, suitable for both a dining set, hospitality, restaurant or barware
STYLE: Vintage blue with hobnail surface, old-fashioned Victorian style
ALTERNATIVE USES: Would also be ideal for home decor, candle making, and votive candle holders; lovely as a wedding or anniversary gift; also use for serving puddings or desserts
